title: Chocolate Chip Banana Cake
intro: Ready in 30 minutes. Makes two 5-inch round cakes.
method: Combine your dry ingredients in a bowl and whisk together
In a new bowl, add in all your wet ingredients and mix well together
Add your wet ingredients to the dry and fold together slowly ( never over mix your batter when there is maida involved as overmixing will result in a dense cake)

caption:
Chocolate Chip Banana Cake 
READY IN 30 MINUTES!! 

Nutrition: 
C: 138 | F: 45 | P: 12
Calories: 1019 per cake (slices into 4 pieces per cake is a decent portion size per person)
Makes 2 - 5 inch round cakes

Recipe below ⬇️

Ingredients: 
Dry
- 120 grams Ap flour
- 75 grams caster sugar
- 20 grams brown sugar 
( If replacing both sugars, you can use 90 grams of jaggery powder) 
- 1/2 tsp baking soda
- pinch of salt
- 1/2 tsp cinnamon
- 1/2 tsp nutmeg

Wet:
- 2 ripe bananas, mashed (feel free to use a third banana if you have it) 
- 1 egg, beated, use 40 grams curd to replace the egg
- 57 grams oil ( vegetable or ghee or melted butter), room tempreture
- 1 tbsp vanilla essence
- 100 grams chocolate chips ( i use @callebautindia OR you can use 50 grams nuts +  60 grams of chocolate chips

Method: 
- combine your dry ingredients in a bowl and whisk together
- in a new bowl, add in all your wet ingredients and mix well together
- add your wet ingredients to the dry and fold together slowly ( never over mix your batter when there is maida involved as overmixing will result in a dense cake)
- add in your chocolate chips and do a few more gentle folds
- 
Baking : 
Tempreture : 170 degres for 20 - 25 minutes
remember to keep checking post the 15 minute mark

Vessel: 
I have used 2 5-inch cake tins.
This recipe can be made in 4 mini tins or double the recipe for a 9 * 5 tin to make a loaf
